newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners net sellers of Japan stocks via 9 firms.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners net sellers of Japan stocks via 9 firms.

text.p: Orders placed by foreign investors through nine foreign securities houses before the start of stock trading on Wednesday showed a net selling stance of 4.1 million shares, market sources said.
Foreign investors' sell orders totalled 17.3 million shares, while buy orders amounted to 13.2 million shares.
